goal: One deterministic, framework-free CreateCustomer@1 Application pipeline from exact raw ActionSpec fields (requestId, actorId, tenantId, payload, idempotencyKey) to one of the closed outcomes ALLOW_COMMIT, DENY, INVALID, CROSS_TENANT_DENY, reusing Identity, PolicyDecisionPoint, Command, PolicyRequest and KernelError, with one injected pure evaluateInvariants collaborator.
nonGoals: No UnitOfWork, begin/commit/rollback or db import is introduced.
No PostgreSQL, RLS, persistence, audit or outbox execution is introduced.
No CommitReceipt is minted; ALLOW_COMMIT means allowed-to-commit only.
No ASGI, Uvicorn, Hypercorn, FastAPI or Django surface is introduced.
No SDK, UI or second journey is introduced.
No new policy logic or duplicated PolicyDecisionPoint evaluation is introduced.
No version bump, release or deploy is performed.

requirements: npm run check must be GREEN
exactly one local full QA run, per the fullQaExecutionsPerChangePackage=2 budget with QA2 external

exitCriteria: the change package net is at most 800 lines
the changed-file set has exact allowed-file parity with allowedFiles
same inputs plus same collaborator answers serialize byte-identically
no readiness, release, MVP or production claim is made anywhere in this package
rollback: Rollback reverts exactly this five-file shard: planning/gj01-v3b-pure-core-pipeline.json, src/application/create-customer-pipeline.mjs, tests/kernel-create-customer-pipeline.test.mjs, tests/repository-boundary.test.mjs, CHANGELOG.md, restoring the base commit's state for each.
